purpose: Evaluate preregistered architecture improvements using local simulation and fresh evaluation records, preserving v0.1 unchanged.

populations.classical: DBpedia14 fresh-task replication. The original shared and moving-encoder content-routing designs are retrained alongside the selected new design on the same data. AG News v0.1 scores provide context only and cannot measure improvement across tasks.
populations.quantum: Independent synthetic development and confirmation populations generated by the preserved circle classification rule. Original scheduled and other controls are retrained on confirmation data. Historical v0.1 results are descriptive context, not paired comparators.
populations.freshness_limit: Exact canonical text overlap exclusion and independent random synthetic populations do not establish freedom from semantic overlap or universal external validity. Test seals are procedural, not encryption.

primary_contrasts.classical: Selected new candidate minus current_content in sealed confirmation-test macro F1, paired by seeds 401 through 405. Higher is better.
primary_contrasts.quantum: Selected new candidate minus scheduled in sealed confirmation-test binary cross entropy, paired by seeds 401 through 405. Lower is better.

classical: Selected new candidate minus shared in macro F1
Current_content minus shared in macro F1
Accuracy, negative log likelihood, charged training time, uncached inference time, route occupancy and assignment stability
quantum: Comparisons with fixed depth four and matched-information MLP129
Small MLP parameter-count controls and registered capacity/exposure mechanism controls
Circuit-example work, layer applications, training visits, gradient diagnostics and local shot sensitivity

estimation.unit: Training seed paired within each fresh task; same evaluation records for every model
estimation.seed_summary: Mean and sample standard deviation across all five registered confirmation seeds. Paired differences receive a descriptive two-sided Student t 95 percent interval with four degrees of freedom. No claim that five seeds establish equivalence or broad population generality.
estimation.evaluation_bootstrap: 2000 paired resamples of unique canonical evaluation groups for classical and evaluation records for quantum, with replacement. A resampled record set is identical across methods and seeds. Average the five seed metrics or paired metric differences within each resample, then report percentile 2.5 and 97.5 percent bounds.
estimation.bootstrap_rng: NumPy PCG64 seed 88002 for classical and 88003 for quantum
estimation.bootstrap_scope: Conditional uncertainty from this fixed set of trained checkpoints and this evaluation population. Does not include model selection uncertainty, new datasets or training-seed variation; do not combine with the seed interval as if independent.
estimation.f1: Unweighted arithmetic mean over all declared task labels, with zero contribution if a class denominator is zero; threshold 0.5 for binary quantum predictions, argmax for classical text predictions.
estimation.multiplicity: One predeclared primary contrast per task. Secondary comparisons and diagnostics are exploratory; no cherry-picked significance statements or multiple-testing claims.
estimation.quantum_engineering_threshold: A mean BCE reduction of at least 0.01 is a predeclared practical signal for further investigation, subject to seed consistency, controls and compute cost. It is not an equivalence margin or proof of quantum advantage.

integrity.selection: Stage A validation selects the new candidate using frozen task-specific rules. Stage B run identities and settings are committed before any sealed test outcome is read. All registered Stage B endpoints must be independently checked before a root-issued release manifest permits evaluation.
integrity.endpoint: Classical primary endpoints are the fixed final main-update checkpoints. Quantum endpoints are the lowest-validation-BCE checkpoint chosen across the full 200-epoch budget, earliest exact tie. These within-task rules apply equally to all compared arms.
integrity.failures: Preserve every registered run, interruption, failure and retry. Do not silently drop unsuccessful seeds or change the training horizon after observing results. If all five paired endpoints cannot be obtained, disclose missingness and do not label a reduced study complete.
integrity.metrics_verification: Independently replay saved checkpoint predictions and independently recompute summary metrics from preserved prediction records. Record source, data, configuration, checkpoint and release hashes.
integrity.runtime: Report actual elapsed study time, overlap between CPU/GPU work, summed training time and exclusions. Timing is local engineering evidence, not a hardware-independent speed or energy benchmark.
integrity.baseline: Verify the original 2081-file v0.1 manifest before and after study. New files and reports are written only in the v0.2 study directories.

publication_and_hardware: All artifacts remain internal. Zero IBM hardware submissions, zero cloud compute jobs and no publication. Local ideal simulation or synthetic noise/shot tests cannot establish IBM hardware accuracy or quantum advantage.
